module: Jbeam loading post-processing step for the "group" column/field of rows (nodes, beams, etc.). Converts each list group = {"a","b"} into a table indexed by a global group number and assigns the row firstGroup (number of the first non-empty group). Produces vehicle.groups, the table group name to number (numbering starting at 0).
notes: Walks all the vehicle's sections (tables) and all their rows (tables) that have a group field of type table; empty strings are ignored.
After processing, row.group becomes a dictionary {number = name} and row.firstGroup the number of the first group; if the row has no non-empty group, it stays unchanged.
Group numbers are assigned in discovery order during the traversal (pairs), so they are not stable from one run to another.

process.desc: Numbers the vehicle's jbeam groups: fills vehicle.groups (name -> number) and transforms the group fields of the rows.

vehicle.desc: Merged jbeam data of the vehicle (modified in place).
